text:
Taylor: Noticed several postmortems with open actions >30 days. proposing a short pilot to tighten ownership and measurability. sketch below.
Nina: +1. what's the pilot scope?
Taylor: Pilot for next 7 incidents across sev levels. enforce: owner ack in 48h, remediation ticket with ETA in 72h, weekly progress until closed, recurrence review at 6 weeks.
Sam: I like the explicit ETA requirement. can we standardize the ETA format so dashboards can parse? e.g., "ETA: 3d (24h blocks)"
Nina: also force a primary + backup owner. primary is accountable, backup steps in if primary is overloaded.
Taylor: yep. template below for the postmortem root and ticket description. tiny so it's easy to copy/paste:
```
PM follow-up template (short)
- Owner (required): <name>
- Backup (required): <name>
- Impact: low / med / high
- ETA (required): e.g., 72h or 5d
- T+48h: owner ack (one-line)
- T+72h: remediation ticket created + PR link if available
- Weekly: brief status until closed (1 line)
- T+42d: automated regression replay scheduled
- T+42d-56d: recurrence review and escalate if repeated
Suggested T+48h ack: "Ack. Impact: med. ETA: 3d. Blockers: none." 
```
DevOpsBot: Action checklist created in #private-action-tracker for thread 1955550000. Reminders set for T+48h and T+72h.
Sam: For rotation, keep IC rotation at 1 week but require IC to be listed on the PM so follow-ups know who to loop. if the incident spans >7d, IC should add a handoff note when they pass the baton.
ProductOps: For exec comms, send a one-line weekly digest for high-impact incidents until closed: "Incident X: owner, ETA, status". keep it short.
Nina: propose success metrics for the pilot: % owner ack within 48h, % remediation tickets with ETA within 72h, median time-to-close, recurrence rate at 6 weeks.
Taylor: plan: run pilot for 7 incidents, collect metrics, then decide. volunteers to audit the first 7?
Sam: I'll help audit and pull the metrics from Jira/dashboard.
DevOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: T+48h ack ping for thread 1955550000.
CTO: Good direction. make the pilot results visible to eng leadership. if we see clear improvement we'll bake the fields into the incident template.
Taylor: thanks all. I'll post the compact template to the incident doc and add example wording. Pilot starts immediately for next incident. :rocket:
